title: 2D Transient Conduction (FEM)
desc.equation: Transient heat conduction in a plate, without internal generation, with constant conductivity k, density ρ and specific heat c_v:
desc.domain: Unit square plate with a 40 × 40 node mesh in a Delaunay triangulation (domain and mesh fixed in the code); time from 0 to (number of steps)·Δt:
desc.bc.sides: Sides, linear profile between the bottom and top temperatures:
desc.ic: Zero temperature in the interior of the plate:
desc.method: Finite Element Method with linear triangular elements and a consistent mass matrix; Crank-Nicolson time integration (θ = 0.5, fixed in the code), with one sparse linear solve per step. The frames are combined into a GIF.
desc.reference: Analytical steady state, linear in y and independent of x, compared with the numerical solution at the center of the plate:
result.title: Heat map (GIF)
py.val.t_final: {t_final:.3f} s ({frac:.1f}% of the diffusive time scale τ_dif = {tau_dif:.2f} s)
